items.title: Aeromexico 787s Get Makeover With New Business Class, Premium Economy
items.why: Cabin upgrades on partner carriers could shape which airlines premium cards feature in future travel benefits.
items.summary_ai: Aeromexico is refitting its Boeing 787 fleet with new business class seats and an upgraded premium economy cabin.
items.take: Cabin upgrades on partner carriers could shape which airlines premium cards feature in future travel benefits.
